name: Vilanova del Camí (Spain)
description: Green field with two central stripes, a narrow white one above a broader yellow one.
history: The flag was approved on 18 May 1993 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1752 of 2 June 1993; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with two central fesses, white and yellow, of 0.33 and 0.99 of the height respectively, dividing the field into two parts of 2.34 each.
